title: 第一卷 第17章 抢阴轿第一卷 第18章 出城之路
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了

“果然有用。”李寒舟见到这一幕，倒是没有害怕。
自从他发现他的道术在这个世界能用之后，李寒舟就知道自己肯定能看到这个世界的鬼魂，并且李寒舟这两天也尝试过一下，的确是在山中看到了一些孤魂野鬼。
之前掐指算过，今天的阴气最重，并且还算到有鬼新娘今天就要嫁娶，所以李寒舟才带着叶紫樱来了。
李寒舟倒是不怕鬼，因为李寒舟很清楚要怎么对付鬼。
“前……前辈，我们撞鬼了？”
叶紫樱此刻吓得小脸有些煞白，她毕竟还只是一个十几岁的小姑娘，什么时候见过这样的场面。
在这个玄天界中，有人族，有妖族，有魔族，但是从未听说过有鬼。
这种东西一直以来都是小说志怪之中才存在的东西，用来吓唬人的，叶紫樱没有想到这天地间竟然还真有这种东西。
如今真的看见了，叶紫樱当真是全身毛骨悚然。
这种未知的东西太恐怖了。
而且李寒舟竟然能带着自己撞鬼，看到这种东西，这李寒舟到底是什么人？
“害怕了？”
李寒舟笑着说。
叶紫樱喉咙滚动，虽然没有回应李寒舟的话，但是却悄悄地后退了一步，忍不住抓住了李寒舟的衣角，就像是个受惊需要人保护的孩子。
此刻那花轿好像是没有看到李寒舟两人一样的继续往前走。
“李前辈，他们……他们过来了。”
叶紫樱这个时候紧张得连声音都在颤抖，她甚至有些后悔今晚来这里了。
然而此刻李寒舟从布袋中拿出来一个铜铃。
叮铃铃。

随着铜铃响起，所有人全部都侧目过来，眼睛盯着李寒舟和叶紫樱。
叶紫樱只感觉寒气瞬间逼来。
“活人拦阴轿……”此刻从那轿子中传来了一个很细的声音。
声音有些瘆人，让人听了很不舒服。
“对不住。”李寒舟走上前一步，抱拳说道：“今晚有事，想要借你的人还有你的阴轿一用，我知道你今晚成亲，就麻烦这位小姐走着去吧？”
“你找死！”
阴轿中的女子勃然大怒，瞬间从里面飞出两道红绫，直奔着李寒舟杀来！
然而李寒舟淡定的看着这一幕，手掌一翻，便是一道八卦镜出现在掌心中，借助天空上的月光照射下来，八卦镜折射出的光芒瞬间轰向那红绫！
砰！
一声炸响，那红绫竟然轰然炸开。
而李寒舟此刻拿出一根蜡烛，一道印诀，蜡烛直接点燃，李寒舟手指点在蜡烛上，蜡烛上的火焰直接出现在李寒舟的手指肚上，旋即顺着那炸开的红绫的轨迹竟然直接化作火蛇喷了过去！
火焰将整个柳树林都给照耀如同白昼一般，火焰烧到了阴轿中，阴轿之中传来了一声惨叫，紧接着一个红衣服的新娘就从阴轿之中飞了出来。

"It really works." Li Hanzhou was not afraid when he saw this scene.
Ever since he discovered that his Taoist skills could be used in this world, Li Hanzhou knew that he would definitely be able to see ghosts in this world, and Li Hanzhou also tried it in the past two days, and indeed saw some lonely ghosts in the mountains.
I had calculated with my fingers before that the yin energy was the heaviest today, and the ghost bride was going to get married today, so Li Hanzhou brought Ye Ziying here.
Li Hanzhou is not afraid of ghosts, because Li Hanzhou knows how to deal with ghosts.
"Senior...Senior, did we bump into a ghost?"
Ye Ziying's face turned pale with fright. After all, she was only a teenage girl. She had never seen such a scene before.
In this Xuantian world, there are humans, demons, and demons, but I have never heard of ghosts.
This kind of thing has always existed in novels and monsters, used to scare people. Ye Ziying did not expect that such a thing actually existed in this world.
Now that she really saw it, Ye Ziying was really terrified.
This unknown thing is so scary.
Moreover, Li Hanzhou can actually lead him to fight against ghosts. Seeing this kind of thing, who is this Li Hanzhou?
"Afraid?"
Li Hanzhou said with a smile.
Ye Ziying's throat rolled. Although she did not respond to Li Hanzhou's words, she quietly took a step back and couldn't help but grab the corner of Li Hanzhou's clothes, like a frightened child who needed protection.
At this moment, the sedan chair continued to move forward as if it didn't see Li Hanzhou.
"Senior Li, they...they are coming."
Ye Ziying was so nervous that her voice was trembling. She even regretted coming here tonight.
But at this moment, Li Hanzhou took out a copper bell from the cloth bag.
Jingle bell bell.
As the bell rang, everyone turned to look sideways, staring at Li Hanzhou and Ye Ziying.
Ye Ziying only felt the coldness coming over her instantly.
"A living person blocks the Yin sedan..." A very thin voice came from the sedan at this moment.
The sound was a little scary, making people feel uncomfortable.
"I'm sorry." Li Hanzhou took a step forward, clasped his fists and said, "I have something to do tonight, and the person who wants to borrow it from you still has your Yin sedan to use. I know you are getting married tonight, so can I trouble this young lady to walk there?"
"You're looking for death!"
The woman in the Yin sedan was furious, and instantly two red ribbons flew out from it, heading straight for Li Hanzhou!
However, Li Hanzhou looked at this scene calmly. When he turned his palm, a Bagua Mirror appeared in his palm. With the help of the moonlight in the sky, the light reflected by the Bagua Mirror instantly hit the red silk!
Bang!
There was an explosion, and the red silk exploded.
At this moment, Li Hanzhou took out a candle, made a seal, and lit the candle directly. Li Hanzhou pointed his finger on the candle, and the flame on the candle appeared directly on the belly of Li Hanzhou's finger. Immediately, following the trajectory of the exploding red silk, it turned into a fire snake and sprayed it!
The flames illuminated the entire willow forest like day, and the flames burned into the Yin sedan. A scream came from the Yin sedan, and then a bride in red clothes flew out of the Yin sedan.
